title: Questions 168-171 refer to the following advertisement.
passage_1:
Ferngate Property Services

Are you tired of spending your holidays clearing the gutters? Let Ferngate Property Services look after your home. We specialize in seasonal roof inspection, gutter clearing, and exterior painting. We can also handle more demanding jobs, such as putting together a condition report or fitting a rainwater tank, and we offer emergency leak repair services.

With over 25 years of experience, we have built a strong reputation for reliability. This is because we are devoted to the satisfaction of our customers. If you are not completely happy with a job, we will come back to address the issues at no extra charge.

To request a quotation, please visit www.ferngatecare.com. You can pick a time slot that suits your week, and one of our experts will visit your home to give you the detailed consultation.
